scientific_integrity: The analytic proof establishes all parameter ranges; numerical checks are supplementary. An equivalent classical projector-reweighting result might exist outside inspected literature. Independent scientific/priority audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only untruncated same-sketch Nyström, continuous operator-monotone functions vanishing at zero, finite real PSD matrices, nuclear/trace residual errors and exact arithmetic. No independent-sketch, truncation, Frobenius, spectral, or Loewner comparison between approximants.
title: Samplewise trace dominance of sketch-before-function Nyström approximation at every rank
